Prayer of the Moment [after the Neve Yaakov synagogue shooting], by Rabbi Avi Novis-Deutsch (Knesset haRabanim l'Yisrael 2023)

tei:div.tei:head: Prayer of the Moment [after the Neve Yaakov synagogue shooting], by Rabbi Avi Novis-Deutsch (Knesset haRabanim l'Yisrael 2023)

tei:lg.tei:l: Out of the depths I call you, Hashem.
My Lord, listen to my cry;
let your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.
If you keep account of sins, Yah,
my Lord, who will survive?
Yours is the power to forgive
so that you may be held in awe.
I and my soul hope for Hashem,
and I await their word.
I am more eager for my Lord
than watchmen for the morning,
O Yisrael, wait for Hashem;
for with Hashem is a steadfast love
and a great power to redeem.
It is they who will redeem Yisrael from all their iniquities. (Psalms 130)
May the One who has dominion over all, Sovereign of Peace,
establish peace in the Land,
and turn aside enmity and hatred.
Send forth your light and your truth
to all its inhabitants,
that they will treat one another with mutual respect.
May they come to see your image in one another,
among all the inhabitants of Erets Yisrael.
Inspire government leaders and advisors
to act with wisdom and patience,
to minimize and remove bloodshed.
Send speedy and full healing to the injured,
and comfort to the families of the dead.
And fulfill the promise made in scripture,
“Nation shall not lift up sword against nation,
nor shall they learn war anymore.” (Isaiah 2:4 part)
And let us say, Amen.
